data.content:
## Build Failure Analysis

**Solution:** `BuildDiag.sln` (3 projects: `Core`, `Services`, `Api`)

---

### Root Cause Error — `Services.csproj`

**3 errors**, all CS0246 in `Services/UserService.cs`:

| Line | Error | Message |
|------|-------|---------|
| 2,7  | CS0246 | `'Newtonsoft'` namespace not found |
| 3,7  | CS0246 | `'Newtonsoft'` namespace not found |
| 22,19| CS0246 | `'JObject'` type not found |

**Diagnosis:** `UserService.cs` uses `Newtonsoft.Json` (via `using Newtonsoft.Json` and `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq`), but `Services.csproj` has **no PackageReference to `Newtonsoft.Json`**.

**Fix:** Add the NuGet package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

---

### Cascading Failure — `Api.csproj`

`Api` has a `<ProjectReference>` to `Services`. Because `Services` failed to compile, `Api` could not build either (the solution build halted). This is **not an independent error** — it will resolve once `Services` compiles successfully.

---

### Non-blocking Warnings (informational only)

The MSB4276 messages about `WorkloadAutoImportPropsLocator` / `WorkloadManifestTargetsLocator` SDK resolution are **benign** — they occur during SDK probing on environments without optional workloads installed and did not cause the build failure.

---

### Summary

| # | Actionable Fix |
|---|----------------|
| 1 | Add `<PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />` to `Services/Services.csproj` |

That single fix should resolve all 3 compiler errors and unblock the `Api` project build.
